nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; set in Owned() from msg.sender and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.

Mapping of account address to token balance; written by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance used by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Constructor: initializes metadata, total supply and pre-mints all tokens to the fixed deployer address; emits Transfer.
Public transfer: subtracts tokens from balances[msg.sender] and adds them to the recipient using SafeMath.
Public approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Public transferFrom: moves tokens using the caller allowance and the sender balance via SafeMath.
Public approveAndCall: sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract.
onlyOwner function that invokes transfer on an arbitrary token contract to recover tokens held by this contract.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stores the pending new owner in newOwner.
Accepts ownership: requires msg.sender == newOwner, transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
Pure addition helper that requires the result to be greater or equal to the first operand.
Pure subtraction helper that requires b <= a before subtracting.
Pure multiplication helper with an overflow check.
Pure division helper that requires a non-zero divisor.
Interface declaration of the callback invoked by approveAndCall on the spender contract.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, balance holder and allowance owner across the contract.
Externally controlled call to spender.receiveApproval() inside approveAndCall, executed after the allowance update.
Externally controlled call to an arbitrary token contract's transfer() in transferAnyERC20Token.

Raw unsigned multiplication c = a * b guarded by an overflow require.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the privileged owner state variable.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender] as the spender.
approveAndCall sets the allowance of msg.sender and passes msg.sender to the callback.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before the arbitrary token call is executed.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer parameter to is used as the balance credit destination.
transfer parameter tokens is passed to safeSub/safeAdd and emitted.
approve parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping.
approve parameter tokens is stored as the allowance value.
transferFrom parameter from is the debited balance holder and allowance owner.
transferFrom parameter to receives the credited balance.
transferFrom parameter tokens is moved from balance and allowance.
approveAndCall parameter spender receives the allowance and is invoked.
approveAndCall parameter tokens sets the allowance and is forwarded.

transferAnyERC20Token parameter tokens is forwarded to the external transfer.
balanceOf parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
allowance parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping.
safeAdd operand a flows into the addition that can wrap around.
safeAdd operand b flows into the addition that can wrap around.
safeSub operand a flows into the subtraction result.
safeSub operand b flows into the subtraction and its bound check.
safeMul operand a flows into the multiplication.
safeMul operand b flows into the multiplication and division check.
safeDiv operand a is the dividend of the division.
safeDiv operand b is the divisor checked by require(b > 0).

approve overwrites the allowed allowance entry.

totalSupply reads _totalSupply.

allowance reads the allowed mapping.

transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.

transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
safeAdd performs the raw unchecked-in-Solidity addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs the raw subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul performs the raw multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs the raw division c = a / b.
approveAndCall invokes an attacker-controlled contract through receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an arbitrary token contract supplied by the caller.
The external call in approveAndCall re-enters the implementation of receiveApproval on the spender.
Local result c of safeAdd carries the addition result that is returned.
